description: Office of the Governor - UVA Province - Twenty Three (23) Appointments Made by the Governor of the Uva Province A. J. M. Muzammi
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple government personnel appointments and acting assignments (e.g., "Eng. Mr. M. T. G. A. N. Lakmal as the Director of Mechanical," "Mr. H. K. P. Jayalath as the Provincial Director of Agriculture") with named individuals and their basic titles/positions. It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these positions, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content focuses solely on personnel changes within the provincial government structure.
